model_version: pic2d v1.4 (v1.3 + wall-ion recycling, peak-node Debye gate, grid-heating triad, CUDA-graph step)

operating_point.neutral_density_role: initial density AND MCC null-collision ceiling n_g0 (= Q_in / c); the recycled fixed point is expected at ~4.1e19 = 0.75 n_g0, so the ceiling margin is smaller than in v2 (n_g > n_g0 fails closed)

neutral_inventory.feed_justification: ATTEMPT 2: Q_in = c n_g0 with c = v_bar A_exit / 4 = 1.5547e-3 m^3/s (xenon at 300 K, v_bar = 220.0 m/s, A_exit = pi (3 mm)^2) and n_g0 = 5.5e19 m^-3: 8.55e16 atoms/s = 0.01864 mg/s. Expected fixed point where nu_iz tau = 1: n_g ~ 3.4e19 with S = Q_in - c n_g = 3.3e16 s^-1 (38 % utilisation) and n_eq = S / (V nu_iz) ~ 2.3e17 (0.58 n_max) if the plasma electrons carry the ionisation; lower if the beam does. Attempt 1 used n_g0 = 5e19 (Q_in = 7.77e16 = 0.01695 mg/s; fixed point at 3.4e19 would have been S = 2.5e16, n_eq ~ 1.8e17) and did not ignite - see 'attempts'
neutral_inventory.relaxation_justification: tau_g = 30 ns is artificial: << ion transit 2.4 us (n_g quasi-steady on plasma time scales), << physical effusion time V/c = 221 us, = 100 series intervals (averages the interval shot noise of S). Only the fixed point is physical; the artificial term has its own ledger so the atom balance closes to round-off
neutral_inventory.recycling_justification: v1.4 (review blocker 3(d)1): every Xe+ absorbed at the dielectric wall and the anode returns to the 0-D inventory as a thermal neutral (gamma = 1.0: Szabo 2001/2014 'recycled into the flow', Brandt et al. 2016 'recycled after wall contact as neutrals'; the review cites no smaller coefficient for BN/Al2O3). Wall temperature 400 K declared between the 300 K feed and Brandt's 500 K; it enters only through the recycled atoms' effusion speed (source-weighted mixture coefficient). Exit-plane ions are the beam and are not recycled. At the v1.3 plateau 59.9 % of the ionisation (2.36e16 of 3.93e16 s^-1) was absorbed at the walls and removed from the atom balance, inflating utilisation: v1.3's 46 % gross corresponds to ~36 % net.
neutral_inventory.relaxation_note: v1.4 makes the artificial relaxation an explicit option (default OFF in the model: relaxation_time_s = null runs on the physical effusion time V/c = 221 us). This development run keeps it ON (30 ns) so the fixed point is reached inside the budget; the flag is recorded in summary.provenance.v1_4_options.neutral_relaxation. Only the fixed point is physical; a plateau under this closure cannot show breathing (review blocker 5).

operating_point.electron_injection_justification: as v2 attempt 2 (3 mA @ 2 eV): unchanged
operating_point.seed_justification: as v2 attempt 2 (5e16 m^-3, 5 eV): the seed that ignited the v1.3 run; unchanged so that the v1.4 result differs from v2 only by the model changes

numerics.dt_justification: as v1.1/v1.2: omega_pe dt = 0.054 at the design ceiling n_max = 4e17; the runtime gate (0.2 on the instantaneous peak node density) trips at 5.6e18 m^-3
numerics.poisson: device block-Thomas direct (exact to round-off, true-residual contract 1e-10 |rhs| verified at every host sync)
numerics.neutral_update_note: the inventory is advanced at every series interval (= sync interval) with the ionisations AND the wall/anode ion absorptions tallied over that interval
numerics.averaging_window_note: consecutive 400000-step (0.6 us) windows; the reported maps are the last completed window (or the current one if at least half full)
numerics.checkpoint_note: checkpoint-latest.{json,npz} rewritten atomically every 40000 steps (60 ns); n_g and the atom ledgers are in the checkpoint arrays; series.jsonl / status.jsonl appended at every 200-step sync

peak_debye_gate.max_cells_per_debye_note: v1.4 fail-closed runtime gate on max(dr, dz) / lambda_D at the densest node holding >= 32 macro-electrons (review blocker 1(d)2: resolve the PEAK, not the mean). Expected 3.7 at the recycled fixed point (v1.3 window-average peak 1.64e18 m^-3 / 7.4 eV gave dz/lambda_D = 3.17; x1.37 in density -> 3.7); 4.5 trips at ~1.5x the expected peak density, i.e. against runaway densification, NOT against the declared 3-4 lambda_D shortfall of this 33 x 50 um grid. Brandt et al. 2016 ran 2 lambda_D per cell; the campaign gate is 2.0 on the 30 um grid (pic2d-campaign-v1-proposal.md).
peak_debye_gate.min_macro_particles_at_peak_note: axis nodes (volume 4.4e-14 m^3) read 1.4e18 m^-3 per single macro-particle at W = 6e4, so the unrestricted argmax is single-particle noise; the node at the v1.3 peak (r = 0.47 mm) holds ~130 macro-electrons; the raw maximum is recorded too

numerics.step_graph_note: v1.4: the whole step is replayed as one CUDA graph per (ion-step, injection, MCC) variant; bitwise-identical to the direct launches (tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_warp_parity.py); the ms/step of this run IS the 1-2 M particle measurement that was pending at commit time (v2 ran 2.0 ms/step at 2.0 M with direct launches)
numerics.anomalous_collisions_note: Bohm hook OFF (base case); campaign block E uses alpha = 1/64 and 1/16

case.seed_note: seed a of the v2 base case: the comparison with v2 isolates the model change

stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for the discharge current, the plasma electron count AND the neutral density (linear fit over the trailing window, drift = slope x window / |mean|), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 2.4 us); additionally the grid-heating triad must be inside its soft bounds (plateau.triad_soft_ok)
stopping_rule.wall_budget_note: 3.5 h cumulative over resumes (run_state.json); the case is resumable if the budget stops it first
stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate, peak-node Debye gate (4.5 cells per lambda_D), grid-heating triad hard bounds after one transit, one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory exhaustion or ceiling violation: the run ends with the artifacts written
stopping_rule.ignition_check: after ~3 minutes: S growing, N_e rising, n_g heading toward the recycled fixed point (~4.1e19, i.e. LESS depletion than v2's 2.97e19), cells/lambda_D at the peak recorded, ms/step with the graph replay; the seed and injection are the ones that ignited v2 attempt 2, so no ignition adjustment is foreseen

grid_heating_triad.note: v1.4 grid-heating triad (review blocker 1(d)3; Birdsall and Maron 1980; Ueda et al. 1994; Adams et al. 2025): (i) cumulative energy-ledger residual / electrode work (v1.3 plateau: -4.4 %; bound 10 %), (ii) trailing-window drifts of the dense-cell T_e and of S, (iii) drift of the peak omega_pe dt. Soft (5 %) is a plateau precondition; hard (25 %, or the residual bound) stops the run fail-closed after one transit time with stop_reason grid_heating_triad_gate_stopped_run.

simplifications: neutrals: 0-D quasi-steady inventory, uniform in space (no neutral flow field, no local depletion where the ionisation is, no local re-emission at the cusp walls); feed prescribed at 300 K, wall/anode ions recycled as 400 K thermal neutrals into the same 0-D inventory, exit-plane effusion; the transient toward the fixed point is artificial (tau_g = 30 ns vs the physical 221 us) and only the fixed point is physical
no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
dielectric wall: perfectly absorbing with accumulated surface charge, zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator), no secondary electron emission, no sputtering
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities/anomalous transport
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger

3 mA injection at 0.017 mg/s feed: a real CFT runs at 0.1-1 A and 0.1-1 mg/s; the self-consistent fixed point of the ionisation-depletion balance, not the absolute current or flow, is the object of this run
single grid (60x480) and weight: the v2 convergence pair (seed-b, w-0.7) bounds variance and W sensitivity at the v1.3 closure only
development/screening run: not preregistered, no experimental validation, not a performance prediction
this 33 x 50 um grid resolves the density peak at 3-4 cells per lambda_D (declared, gated at 4.5): a grid claim needs the 30 um campaign grid and the 20 um discriminator
claim_boundary: development/screening PIC-MCC steady-state run with a 0-D quasi-steady neutral inventory including wall-ion recycling; not preregistered; not validated against experiment; not a thruster performance prediction; the neutral transient is artificial and only the fixed point is physical; the peak is resolved at 3-4 cells per lambda_D on this grid

v2_reference.use: the v1.4 run is compared with the v1.3 plateau at the same operating point: the difference is the model change (recycling), not variance (seed-b bounds variance at <= 1.1 % on the plateau quantities)

budget_v1_4.n_eq_projected_over_n_max: 0.58-0.83 (0.73 at the self-consistent recycled fixed point)
budget_v1_4.ion_transit_note: the MEASURED ion residence time N_i / L of the v2 fine cases (2.35-2.43 us after 1 us)

recycled_fixed_point_estimate.self_consistent: with the ionisation conductance k = S/n_g = 1.32e-3 m^3/s and wall share f_w = 0.60 held at the v1.3 values: n_g* = Q_in / (c + (1 - f_w) k) = 4.10e19 m^-3 (+38 %); S = k n_g* = 5.4e16 s^-1 (gross 63 %), R = 3.2e16, net (S - R)/Q_in = 25 %, beam ~3.5 mA
recycled_fixed_point_estimate.brandt_2016_context: Brandt et al. 2016 (different device, static neutrals, Bohm + SEE): net ionisation 24 %, beam 2.5 mA of 4.3 mA anode current; quoted as model-to-model context labelled by closure, never as validation

budget_v1_4.expected_duration: 3 transits = 4.8e6 steps; with the graph replay at ~3.3 M particles the step is expected at 1.5-2.5 ms -> 2.0-3.3 h, inside the 3.5 h budget only if the plateau is declared at the first eligible checkpoint; the case is resumable
